行动图标.intro: Marks effects tied to the Action Count.

正交相邻.intro: Only affects orthogonally adjacent cells or units.

攻击.intro: Attack: the base value of damage dealt.

死亡.intro: Effects tied to death or kills.

潜伏近战.intro: When the countdown hits zero: if orthogonally adjacent to the player, flip face-down.

普通攻击.intro: A regular attack made by the player within attack range.

移动计数.intro: +1 whenever its owner makes a move.

链接近战.intro: Melee attack shared by linked monsters.

远程武器.intro: No first strike or counter when the player engages it; volleys unaffected.

神圣决斗.intro: After fighting it, fighting other monsters deals 2 damage to you; clears when it flips or leaves.

潜伏.intro: When the countdown hits zero: if orthogonally adjacent to the player, flip face-down.

链接.intro: Forms a link with adjacent linked monsters.

逃避.intro: After combat: swaps with a random card in a corner cell; skips if none, or after lethal damage.

起来.intro: After it damages you: a random face-up monster flips face-down.

吸收.intro: When an adjacent monster is removed: gains a random buff.

献火.intro: On removal: a Flame joins the fight.

剧烈燃烧.intro: Each Flame added to the combat deck brings one more; no recursion.

损耗.intro: When a monster is removed: this card attack -1, HP -10.

快递.intro: Every 5 moves: swaps an adjacent Item Card with a combat-deck monster.

历战.intro: In combat: per 2 total damage dealt to you, its attack +1.

嘲讽.intro: While adjacent, you may only fight this card.

叠甲.intro: Every 6 Interactions: other monsters gain 2 Armor.

天涯若比邻.intro: All monster cards count as orthogonally adjacent; skill adjacency only.

刺客领袖.intro: While face-up: monsters flip face-down as they are played.

死亡之主.intro: When another monster is removed: plays a Revive Stone to that cell.

烈焰沸腾.intro: Per 5 of your Interactions: Flame damage +1; stacks.

吞云吐雾.intro: Every 5 Interactions: consumes all Flames on board, dealing damage per Flame.

生生不息.intro: When a Flame is removed: shuffles in another Flame.

空间掌握.intro: After you fight it: the board rotates once.

转动.intro: On entry: rotates the board once.

献身.intro: On removal: other monsters on board gain +1 attack.

跳杀.intro: On flipping face-up while orthogonally adjacent to you: deals its attack.

提速.intro: Each time it damages you: other monsters' countdowns tick down by 1.

链接战术.intro: Adjacent monsters gain +1 attack; ends when adjacency breaks. Aura.

链接准备.intro: Every 5 Interactions: removes adjacent Item Cards.

链接护甲.intro: Every 3 Interactions: adjacent monsters gain +1 Armor.

盗取.intro: On flipping face-up: removes a random adjacent Item Card.

呼唤.intro: Every 5 Interactions: calls a Melee 6 into the combat deck.

死亡召唤.intro: On removal: plays a Revive Stone to its cell.

吟唱.intro: Every 6 Interactions: calls a Melee 3 into the combat deck.

技能同步触发.intro: This card carries a skill synced to its countdown: when the count hits zero, the attack and the skill fire on the same beat, without spending an extra count.
